description: Save a strategy to your Lab: a name plus a strategy spec (wallet source — any Builder ranking, a history ranking, a static wallet list or a copy-engine sleeve — and market, entry, sizing and exit rules), or a template_id to copy a template. The server validates the spec and answers with the reason when it refuses. Needs POLYRANK_API_KEY.
name: polyrank_create_strategy
title: Strategy Lab: save a strategy
